column1: # Bhojpuri word gold set: hand-written broad pronunciations (Devanagari word, IPA), written 2026-11-14 before any
# Bhojpuri work. Word sources: F = attested in FLORES-200 bho_Deva dev/devtest (CC BY-SA 4.0, text used for
# evaluation only, https://github.com/facebookresearch/flores); L = forms in Grierson, Linguistic Survey of India
# vol. V part II (1903, public domain, https://archive.org/details/in.ernet.dli.2015.32969) grammar sketch of
# Bhojpuri; S = the example words of the project's language description (words only). Pronunciation: written by hand from
# Shukla 1981, Bhojpuri Grammar, and Tiwari 1960 (vowels a aː i iː u uː e eː o oː ə, ऐ = əi, औ = əu, vowel letters
# इ उ after a vowel are their own vowel, ड़ ढ़ = ɽ ɽʰ, avagraha = pronounced final ə, final inherent vowel silent
# after a single consonant, Hindi-type medial schwa deletion, nasal vowels from chandrabindu and from anusvara
# before a fricative or at the end). Notation: espeak-style Hindi symbols (c ɟ ʋ ɾ ʃ), aspiration ʰ.
# Category tags: hiatus, diph, flap, avagraha, verb, cop, noun, adj, pron, post, num, misc.
# Bhojpuri sentence gold set: short sentences written for this set on the patterns of Shukla 1981 (Bhojpuri
# Grammar) and Grierson's LSI vol. V part II (1903, public domain), with vocabulary attested in FLORES-200 bho_Deva
# (CC BY-SA 4.0); hand-written broad pronunciation of every word (conventions as words.src). Written 2026-11-14
# before any Bhojpuri work. Format: sentence <TAB> pronunciation (words separated by spaces).
# Columns: id, kind, text, expected, category, source, split. Date of all items: 2026-11-14.
